segments.sn17.24:1.3: saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā ekaṃ dhītaraṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya –
segments.sn17.24:1.4: ‘tādisā, ayye, bhavāhi yādisā khujjuttarā ca upāsikā veḷukaṇḍakiyā [veḷukaṇḍakī (sī. chakkaṅguttarepi)] ca nandamātā’ti.
segments.sn17.24:1.5: Esā, bhikkhave, tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ, yadidaṃ khujjuttarā ca upāsikā veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca nandamātā.
segments.sn17.24:1.6: Sace kho tvaṃ, ayye, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajasi;
segments.sn17.24:1.7: tādisā, ayye, bhavāhi yādisā khemā ca bhikkhunī uppalavaṇṇā cāti.
segments.sn17.24:1.8: Esā, bhikkhave, tulā etaṃ pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ, yadidaṃ khemā ca bhikkhunī uppalavaṇṇā ca.
segments.sn17.24:1.9: Mā ca kho tvaṃ, ayye, sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātūti.
segments.sn17.24:1.10: Taṃ ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuniṃ sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti, so tassā hoti antarāyāya.
segments.sn17.24:1.11: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe …
